Tens of Thousands of Dollars Just on Upgrades? Turning an Ordinary Car into a 5 Star Hotel

Company homepage and sales site : https://lmmotors.kr/
email : LMmotors@naver.com

Hello, this is King Process.
How much can an ordinary car change with tens of thousands of dollars spent on customization alone? In this video, we visit LM Motors, a custom vehicle manufacturer in Paju, South Korea, to see a brand-new Kia Carnival transformed into a limousine with hotel-like comfort.
Reclining seats, a starlit ceiling, colorful mood lighting, and a built-in screen turn the familiar Carnival into a completely different space. Customers can also choose leather colors and materials to suit their personal taste.
Watch the video to see just how comfortable and luxurious the inside of an ordinary car can become.
If you enjoyed the video, please like and subscribe. What kind of space would you create inside your car? Let us know in the comments!
